rationale: Introduce a smooth bounded routing pressure term using softplus of the sum of soft_rudy_pnorm and route_pressure_long to gently penalize congestion hotspots while preserving differentiability. This mechanism explicitly integrates routing pressure beyond the baseline wirelength and density terms, addressing routing-related objectives missing in the current baseline. Use a small coefficient (0.05) to avoid aggressive spreading and instability. Returning all components for analysis and interpretability. This is a routing-aware mechanism distinct from prior negative attempts involving multiplicative or sigmoid interaction, using a different smooth transform. Calibrated coefficients for Tier-2 search: route=3e-08, density=None, wirelength=None.
